# Optional mechanism utilities

Mechanism utilities are intentionally excluded from runtime v1. Exact Reverse, State Reset, Selective Deletion, K/P factorial, and Exact R2 have separate formal authorities and experiment-specific schemas. Copying them into the core Fixed + Dynamic package would expand ambiguity and is not required for core integrity. This exclusion does not affect Fixed evaluation, Sample Best, Dynamic LB, aggregation, bootstrap, or integrity audit.
